sources.title: NVIDIA Parakeet - Speech-to-Text Model | STT.ai
sources.snippet: NVIDIA Parakeet TDT 1.1B is a state-of-the-art English ASR model using FastConformer architecture with Token-and-Duration Transducer (TDT). It achieves near-human accuracy on standard English benchmarks and is highly optimized for NVIDIA GPUs.

sources.snippet: Back to index Nithin Rao Koluguri · @nithinraok Somshubra Majumdar · @titu1994 2024-01-03 · 5 minute read Announcing NVIDIA NeMo Parakeet ASR Models for Pushing the Boundaries of Speech Recognition We announce the release of Parakeet, a family of state-of-the-art automatic speech recognition (ASR) models. Learn more in our team's post on the NVIDIA Techblog.

sources.title: STT - Speech-to-Text with Speaker Diarization - GitHub
sources.snippet: STT - Speech-to-Text with Speaker Diarization A macOS command-line utility wrapping the FluidAudio library providing speech-to-text transcription with speaker diarization using the Parakeet v3 model.
